title: Stock Profit Calculator
description: Work out net profit, return percentage and breakeven price for any stock trade with commissions.
howto: Enter the buy price, number of shares and buy commission.
Enter the sell price and sell commission.
Read net profit, return % and the breakeven sell price.

faqs.a: The sell price per share where profit is exactly zero: (buy cost + both commissions) ÷ shares.
Net profit ÷ total buy cost (shares × buy price + buy commission), as a percent.
No — only the price trade. Add dividends received to the sell proceeds mentally for total return.
